ledger: Indoor gravity and still air (00:00-00:06): evidenced by the subject's settled hair, motionless striped shirt collar, and the limp vertical hang of the blue coat on the background hook; affects all garments consistently.

Subject turning and walking motion (00:07-00:09): evidenced by the man pivoting left and stepping toward the door to knock; should affect only his own clothing and body, leaving background hanging garments undisturbed.

Background hanging blue coat (00:07-00:09): despite no physical contact from the subject and no indoor airflow affecting the subject's hair or shirt, the hanging coat flares outward and shifts its hanging geometry.

findings.description: As the man turns and walks to the left without touching the background hook, the blue coat hanging behind him flares outward into a wide bell shape and shifts position along the door despite still indoor air and no corresponding movement in the subject's hair or shirt.
